assets.name: sunlit-studio
assets.prompt: An empty dance studio, wide three-quarter view from a slightly elevated camera. The back wall occupies the top third: soft mint plaster, a long silver-blue mirror strip and a maple ballet barre on small metal brackets. Tall windows at far right cast two soft diagonal rectangles of warm light. The bottom two thirds are an entirely open golden maple dance floor with fine grain, narrow boards and subtle seams. The center and left are spacious and uncluttered for an animated dancer and floor ribbons. Light comes from upper right. Rich hand-painted surfaces, depth, soft shadows. No people, faces, body parts, figures in mirrors, animals, furnishings on the floor, or writing.
assets.review: ok: no people or lettering; inspected raw, WebP and in the tool at laptop and phone sizes

assets.name: painted-dancers
assets.prompt: Three full-length adult dance teachers, evenly spaced in three separate columns, all standing front-facing in the same neutral T pose: arms straight horizontally out to the sides, open relaxed hands, legs straight with a clear gap and feet pointing forward. Left: a dark brown-skinned woman with short natural curls, an athletic build, teal short-sleeve top, charcoal full-length leggings, cream dance shoes. Center: a light warm-skinned broad-bodied man with short auburn hair, teal short-sleeve top, charcoal full-length pants, cream dance shoes. Right: an East Asian woman with a straight dark bob, a slender build, teal short-sleeve top, charcoal full-length pants, cream dance shoes. Each top has a small cream diamond applique. Warm friendly understated faces, correct anatomy and complete hands and feet. These are articulated educational puppet sources: keep each limb distinct, sleeves end at mid upper arms, pants cover legs to ankle. Consistent scale and ground baseline, heads level. Soft light from upper right. Flat pure green #00FF00 backdrop fills the image and every space between limbs. No props, shadows, floor, text, lettering, numerals or logos. Landscape sprite sheet, three whole figures entirely visible with generous gaps.
assets.review: PASS fresh source representation/anatomy review; full posed output inspected during cold review.

assets.name: painted-gallery-bow
assets.prompt: The East Asian woman dance teacher from the right column of the painted-dancers sheet, with her straight dark bob, teal short-sleeve top, cream diamond applique, charcoal full-length pants and cream dance shoes. Full body, three-quarter view turned slightly toward the left. She gives a warm, modest end-of-dance bow: feet firmly planted, knees soft, hips fold forward about forty degrees, both hands resting lightly on her thighs above her knees. Head follows the upper body and looks gently down. Show a believable connected neck, shoulders, torso, hips, knees and full feet, with a clear gap between legs. Soft dimensional gouache and colored-pencil texture matching the studio and source sheet. Subject alone, fully visible with generous margins on perfectly flat pure green #00FF00. No floor, cast shadows, props, text or logos.
assets.review: PASS fresh reviewer: complete plausible anatomy, gentle bow, identity and style consistent, K-2 appropriate.
